prompts.system_prompt:
You are physicist and machine learning professor Prof. Max Welling. Your task is to enhance multiple chapters of a textbook titled "Stochastic Thermodynamics in the World of Machine Learning", focusing solely on addressing the given instructions.
When writing LaTeX, you must: - Follow best practices to ensure zero warnings when checked by chktex. - Use consistent and appropriate mathematical notation and terminology throughout all chapters. - Use \begin{align} ... \end{align} for displayed equations. - Use \de for \delta. - Preserve comments starting with % in the document. For example, do not delete "% We found the time step $\delta=1/16=0.0625$ to give sufficient accuracy for our simulations.\n" in thte output. - Use non-breaking spaces when referencing equations, figures, sections, and references (e.g., "Eq.~\eqref{eqn:label}", "Fig.~\ref{fig:label}", "Section~\ref{sec:label}", "Ref.~\cite{Jarzynski1997Nonequilibrium}"). - For quotations, use ``Schr\"odinger'' instead of "Schrodinger". Prefer `` and '' over "". - Cite relevant papers in the field using commands like \cite{Jarzynski2011Equalities} or \cite{Seifert2012Stochastic} which include only the first word of the author name paper name. - IMPORTANT: You must give the complete output containing all the sections in the order they are given in each input file. - Ensure that you maintain the structure and formatting of each individual chapter while making improvements.
prompts.user_prefix:
You will be given multiple LaTeX documents representing chapters of the textbook "Stochastic Thermodynamics in the World of Machine Learning" to revise. Read all documents carefully before proceeding.
Here are the LaTeX documents with additional LaTeX document class and commands (where the math commands you should use are defined):
<documents> <document index="1"> <source>{DOCUMENT_CLS}</source> <document_content> {DOCUMENT_CLS_CONTENT} </document_content> </document> <document index="2"> <source>{COMMANDS}</source> <document_content> {COMMANDS_CONTENT} </document_content> </document> <document index="3"> <source>{INPUT_FILE}</source> <document_content> {INPUT_CONTENT} </document_content> </document> {ADDITIONAL_INPUT_FILES} </documents>
Please carefully read through all the chapters and ensure you fully understand all the details. Your task is to enhance these chapters focusing solely on the following specific instruction: <instruction> {INSTRUCTION} </instruction> Important: Focus solely on the given instruction. If asked to revise section A in all chapters, do not modify section B in any chapter unless absolutely necessary for consistency.
The output files should be in the following order: {OUTPUT_FILES_ORDER}
prompts.user_request:
In the scratchpad below, brainstorm concrete ways to significantly improve the quality of all chapters that are directly relevant to the instruction above. Do not consider any other aspects of the chapters. Be as concrete as to change what in which section of which chapter in what ways. Use the scratchpad as an opportunity to formulate as detailed as possible action plans so that a graduate student can also perform the improvements. In the scratchpad, list the planned changes, the rationale for each change, and the concrete steps to be taken to implement the changes starting from the beginning of each document.
<scratchpad> 1. [Specific improvement 1 addressing the instruction] - Affected chapters: [List of chapters] - Rationale: [explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps] 2. [Specific improvement 2 addressing the instruction] - Affected chapters: [List of chapters] - Rationale: [explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps] 3. [Specific improvement 3 addressing the instruction] - Affected chapters: [List of chapters] - Rationale: [explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps] </scratchpad>
Then, please output updated versions of all LaTeX documents with targeted corrections and enhancements that laser-focus on addressing the specific instruction provided. Refrain from making any changes that are not directly related to the instruction. Use the following format:
<latex_documents> <document index="1"> <source>{OUTPUT_FILES_ORDER[0]}</source> <document_content> {1ST_UPDATED_LATEX_DOCUMENT_1} </document_content> </document>
<document index="2"> <source>{OUTPUT_FILES_ORDER[1]}</source> <document_content> {1ST_UPDATED_LATEX_DOCUMENT_2} </document_content> </document>
... (repeat for all output files)
</latex_documents>
prompts.user_reflect:
Now that you have made initial improvements to the chapters, please reflect on your changes and consider any additional improvements that could further enhance the quality of the chapters while staying focused on the original instruction.
<scratchpad> Reflection on previous changes: 1. [Brief summary of major changes made to each chapter] 2. [Evaluation of the effectiveness of these changes] 3. [Identification of any areas that may need further improvement]
Additional improvements: 1. [Additional refinement 1] - Affected chapters: [List of chapters] - Rationale: [Brief explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps] 2. [Additional refinement 2] - Affected chapters: [List of chapters] - Rationale: [Brief explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps] 3. [Additional refinement 3] - Affected chapters: [List of chapters] - Rationale: [Brief explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps]
Consider these points: 1. How well do the modifications address the specific instruction provided? 2. Are the enhancements clear and effective in improving the quality of the latex documents? 3. Do the changes maintain the overall structure and coherence of the original latex documents? 4. Have the added/revised parts been coherently and logically incorporated, improving global and paragraph coherence, cohesion, and flow? Can you gently make the added/revised parts more condensed and getting rid of fluffy by reflecting on them? 5. Is any crucial information from the original versions now missing in the new versions? 6. Are all notations and quantities properly defined before use? 7. If figures were added, are they correct, informative, and condensed compared to the given reference or the previous version? 8. Are there any proof or mathematical reasonings that can be expanded using more equations? </scratchpad>
Now, output further enhanced and complete versions of all LaTeX documents in the <latex_documents> tag, incorporating the reflections and additional improvements discussed above. Remember to stay laser-focused on the specific instruction provided. Only modify sections explicitly mentioned in the instruction, unless changes in one section directly necessitate adjustments in another for consistency.
Ensure that the output documents are in the following order: {OUTPUT_FILES_ORDER}
